name: discover/detail-hero
title: DetailHero
summary: The top of the page for one item reached from a Discover page (an article, an event, a public circle, a place): breadcrumb, eyebrow, the page's one <h1>, when and where, a lead, the actions, and the item's image or media.

props.name: title
props.description: The item's name: the page's only <h1>.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: The service, source or category above the title, e.g. "Mukoko Events".

props.name: image
props.description: The item's image URL, 16:9; replaced by the `media` slot.

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Alt text when the image says something the title does not.

props.name: dateLabel
props.description: The time as read: when it starts (event) or was published (article).

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Under the lead: "Open in Mukoko" and the other actions.

slots.name: media
slots.description: Replaces `image`, e.g. a weather figure or a map.

behaviour: The title is the page's only <h1>; the hero is a <header> in <main> (no banner landmark).
When and where (`dateLabel`, `place`) are a list under the title, each with a decorative icon; the time is a <time datetime>.
The image is the item's own: eager (it is likely the largest paint), sized 1200×675 at 16:9, decorative by default (`imageAlt` "").
With an image or media the hero is two columns from 64rem, text first, and exposes `data-media="true"`; without, one column.
Server-filled shells: every text prop is a plain string, and text that fills to "" hides itself (`empty:hidden`).

props.title: Jacaranda Music Festival
props.lead: Three days of music under the jacarandas, free for everyone.

article.description: A news article: a published date, no place, no image.

media.description: A place, with a weather figure in the media slot.

keyboard: Through the breadcrumb, then the actions; the hero has no stops of its own.
focus: Its slots' links show the `--ring` focus outline.
aria: One <h1>; the when-and-where icons are aria-hidden (the text says it); the image is decorative unless `imageAlt` says more.

theming.brandOverlay: None of its own: the eyebrow and the slots' actions carry the brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: One column on phones: text, then the image or media at full width.
From 64rem, with media, two columns, text first; the title balances its lines and text keeps the prose measure.
contract:
contract
  slot is "detail-hero"
  uses icon
  uses detail-hero-when
  uses detail-hero-media
  when default shows h1 "Jacaranda Music Festival"
  when default shows time "Sat 24 Oct, 18:00"
  when default shows a "Open in Mukoko"
  when article shows h1 "Rains arrive early in Mashonaland"
  when media shows span "1,490 m above sea level"
  when template shows h1 "{{name}}"
end

checks.say: The image is decorative, eager and sized.
The breadcrumb sits above the title.
The media slot replaces the image.
